content.text:
**Ilana's thinking as she reads:**

- "קרנות סל"? Not a word I know. Not deposits. Still, I'm asked to choose, so I'll look.
- First picture: "אי.בי.אי. סל (4A) ת"א 125", and then English letters, "S&P 500" and "MSCI AC World". I'd read those out letter by letter.
- Under "המדד" it just says "ת"א-125". To me מדד is the prices on the news. What does it follow? It doesn't say.
- The second picture has the same table, but the heading says "המדד ומה יש בו". Under it: "מאה עשרים וחמש החברות בעלות השווי הגבוה ביותר בבורסה בתל אביב". So it's shares of big companies. That I understand.
- "חמש מאות החברות הגדולות בארצות הברית" for S&P. Now I know what those letters are.
- Fees: "0.35% קבועים", "0.1% משתנים", "0.008% נאמן". נאמן means nothing to me, and I don't know what קבועים and משתנים are. Do I add them up? I won't.
- Every row has the same little labels again: "צוברת", "מחזיקה את המניות", "עסקת החלף", "חשיפה לדולר", "מס גם על שינויי המטבע". I read them on every row to find what's different. Tiring.
- "מס גם על שינויי המטבע" sounds like they take more from me. I back away from those two.
- Black background, grey writing. Hard on my eyes even enlarged.

**What I'd tell my son:**

I'd take the second one, and I'm fairly sure. It's the only one that tells me in plain Hebrew what each fund holds. The first just gives me "ת"א-125" and English letters. Mind you, none of these is for me. It's all shares, nothing like my deposits, and I wouldn't put money in without asking you or the bank.

What I looked at, in order: the heading "קרנות סל", the line saying "דמי הניהול לפי הדוח", the fund names, the מדד column, the fees, and the labels under each name. In the second picture I read the Hebrew lines under the מדד. I didn't look at the paper numbers ("מספר נייר"), and I didn't click "בדף הקרן במאיה".

What I didn't understand: קרנות סל, 4A and 4D, S&P 500, MSCI AC World (until the second picture explained them), צוברת, עסקת החלף, חשיפה לדולר, נאמן, and what קבועים and משתנים mean. The first picture's column headings were pale grey on black, hard to read.

What bothered me: the same labels repeated on every row, so I had to read them all again to find what was different. In the second picture they even break onto a second line. "מס גם על שינויי המטבע" worried me. And with three fees per fund and no total, I can't tell which one is cheap.
